name: Objective 06 screening pool, round 2
status: DEVELOPMENT MATERIAL (D-110). Round 1 (screening-pool.json, runs/2026-11-09/screening/) gave only four wordings at or under the lead's 0.25 floor: S1f, S2c, S4c, S4d. This round adds wordings for the three subjects still short (salary review needs one, corporate card one, christmas shutdown two), screened by the same rule, scores only, no generation. It also carries the draft thirty's seven answerable asks, as ordinary questions, so their top scores show whether any would take path A and wrongly enter the gap log; those seven are a check, not a selection.
notes: Round 1's lesson: 'pay', 'paid', 'leave', 'office', 'closed', 'shut down' and 'company' pull D01, D10 or D20 over 0.25. These wordings avoid them where the subject allows.
Kept: for each subject, the two lowest-scoring wordings across both rounds at or under 0.25, one per role where the scores allow.
